listingTitle: AMADA Bathroom Shelves with Towel Bar, Set of 2, Light Brown
listingLines: Wide Use Scenes - Our floating shelves for wall not only can be used in the living rooms, bedrooms, but also the bathrooms and kitchens. Perfect for displaying and holding collectibles, small plants, frames, and more.

High Weight Capacity - The bathroom shelves crafted with 0.59 inches thick Paulownia wood, powder-coated metal bracket, and torched finish, the floating shelves are sturdy and strong enough for holding 22lbs of items. Decor and organized your home more beautifully and neatly.

Detachable Towel Bar - Thanks to the bathroom shelves' detachable towel bar, you can hang your towels, clean clothes, headphones, or kitchenware on it when you install the towel bar under the floating shelves board. Besides, you can also detach the towel bar at your will.

Item Dropping Guard- 3-side protective guard around the bath bathroom wall shelves keep your items safe, preventing the items next to the one you take on the floating shelves from dropping. Also, the metal brackets are crafted with powder-coated finish without rust.
Easy to install - Step 1, unfold the bathroom shelves' bracket; step 2, install the board and the towel bar; step 3, affix the bracket on the wall. Applicable wall: Wood Stud, Drywall, Concrete Wall.
summary: This set of two light brown floating shelves provides a dedicated space to display and organize items in various rooms around the home. They help solve storage issues by utilizing wall space for collectibles, plants, and household essentials while offering a protective guard to keep items secure.
highlights: Crafted with 0.59-inch thick Paulownia wood and powder-coated metal brackets with a torched finish.
Features a three-sided protective guard to prevent items from falling off the edges.
Includes a detachable towel bar that can be installed under the shelf board or removed as needed.
Designed to support a weight capacity of up to 22lbs.
Compatible with wood stud, drywall, and concrete wall installations.
bestFor: Bathrooms for holding toiletries and hanging towels or clean clothes.
Kitchens for organizing kitchenware and small pantry items.
Living rooms and bedrooms for displaying frames, small plants, and collectibles.
stylingTips: Install the detachable bar under the shelf in a bedroom to keep headphones organized and accessible.
Use the three-sided guard to safely display fragile collectibles or small potted plants in the living room.
Mount the shelves in the kitchen to store spices on the wood board while hanging frequently used kitchenware from the bar.
beforeYouBuy: Check the listing for the specific dimensions of the boards to ensure they fit your intended wall space.
Verify that your wall type is wood stud, drywall, or concrete to ensure the brackets can be properly affixed.
Check the listing for the exact shade of the light brown torched finish to ensure it matches your existing decor.

faq.question: How much weight can these shelves hold?
faq.answer: The shelves are sturdy enough to hold up to 22lbs of items when properly installed.

faq.question: Can the towel bar be used for things other than towels?
faq.answer: Yes, the detachable bar can also be used to hang clean clothes, headphones, or kitchenware.

faq.question: What prevents items from falling off the shelves?
faq.answer: The shelves feature a three-sided protective guard designed to keep your items safe and prevent them from dropping.
